page.overview:
Who is Fractal Yog-Sothoth?

The Fractal Yog-Sothoth (also known as Lord of the Fractal Realm) is a fictional entity created by Scott David Aniolowski for Chaosium's role-playing game Call of Cthulhu, depicted as being an avatar of the Outer God known as Yog-Sothoth. (: Ye Booke of Monstres II)

Appearing as an agglomeration of coruscating rainbow-coloured geometric shapes surrounding a central mass of tentacles, the Fractal Yog-Sothoth is rarely encountered in the real world; nevertheless it is occasionally stumbled across by unwitting computer users. When its bizarre dimension is accessed, the Fractal Yog-Sothoth immediately forces its way through the user's now-destroyed computer screen and grows to a terrifying size, lashing out with its appendages: any living being touched by the Fractal is instantly absorbed by it.

Being an entity composed entirely of energy, the Fractal Yog-Sothoth cannot be harmed by any physical means. However, it is vulnerable to energy-based weapons and effects, and the switching off or restarting of the computer which it used as a gateway may act to cast it back to its own dimension. (: Ye Booke of Monstres II)

It has been suggested that entities other than Yog-Sothoth possess fractal avatars in this other dimension, although if any of them have been encountered by humans there have been no survivors left to tell the tale.
